items.name: colors
items.title: Colours
items.description: The base colour scales (white, grey, primary, danger, success, warning) as CSS variables. Part of ftds-init.

items.name: theme-light
items.title: Light theme
items.description: The light theme semantic tokens (bg, txt, otl, fr) on top of the base colours. Part of ftds-init.

items.name: theme-dark
items.title: Dark theme
items.description: The dark theme semantic tokens, applied under the .dark class. Part of ftds-init.

items.name: theme-config
items.title: Tailwind theme
items.description: The Tailwind CSS v4 @theme: token utilities, type scale, radii, shadows, densities and control utilities. Part of ftds-init.

items.name: base-styles
items.title: Base styles
items.description: Base layer and utility CSS FTDS components rely on. Part of ftds-init.

items.name: ftds-init
items.title: FTDS styles
items.description: Everything FTDS needs in one stylesheet (styles/ftds.css): colours, light and dark themes, the Tailwind theme and base styles. Install this first.
